card.name: Inside medical abbreviations in parentheses
card.fires_on: Short letter chunks that start or sit inside an abbreviation, usually right after an opening parenthesis, such as pc in pcJIA, vg for vector genomes, or sa in BSA.

modes.label: Abbreviation in brackets
modes.description: The first letters of an abbreviation given in parentheses after a spelled-out term.

modes.label: Inside dose-unit abbreviations
modes.description: Middle letters of body surface area (BSA) written after a slash or letter.
